principle: Defined from physical and economic plausibility before any outcome is seen. Generated sites are never selected, reweighted or adjusted by any outcome-related property (prior strength, learning space, method performance). Exclusion only by pre-registered numerical or mechanical rules, all reported.

sampling.method: Each site draws every component independently from its own stream: numpy Generator seeded with the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 over distribution_id, master_seed, site_index and the component name. Applied values: value = x; times = base * x; plus = base + x; times_site_value = the site value of that parameter (which the site level must set) * x.
sampling.master_seed: committed with a salt before the formal sites are generated; development and pilot seeds are separate

temperature_window_shift_c.note: Cultivars differ in temperature response; optimum night temperatures for fruit set are commonly reported between 15 and 20 C. A +/-1.5 C shift of the model's 24 h inhibition window is a declared assumption, not a fitted cultivar range.

photosynthetic_capacity_factor.note: Leaf electron-transport capacity varies with cultivar and leaf physiology; +/-15% around the model value is a declared assumption.

fruit_growth_potential_factor.note: Generative sink strength differs between cultivars; declared assumption.

earliness_factor.note: Temperature sum to full generative phase; declared assumption.

max_lai.note: Canopy management and cultivar; declared assumption around the model value 3.

cover_par_nir_transmission.note: Whole-greenhouse PAR transmission of clear-glass Venlo houses is about 0.73-0.76 in winter; single glass about 0.90; anti-reflective diffuse glass higher.

leakage_coefficient.note: De Zwart's model uses 0.3e-4; the pinned model uses 1e-4; closed-vent air exchange ranges from about 0.75 per hour (new glass) to 2-4 per hour (old glass in poor condition), a factor of several.

ventilation_coefficient_factor.note: Vent geometry and screens change discharge and wind-pressure coefficients; +/-20% is a declared assumption.

side_wall_exchange_w_m2_k.note: Contract-defined boundary exchange with neighbouring spaces; the contract already lists it for sensitivity (0-4).

led_par_efficacy_fraction.note: With 5.4 umol PAR per J PAR this is 2.4-3.2 umol/J, within and slightly above the 2-3 umol/J typical of horticultural LED fixtures reported by Kusuma et al. (2020).

deep_soil_boundary_c.note: Decided in contract v4; the true ~2 m soil temperature under the facility is unknown.

energy_price_factor.note: One factor moves electricity and heat together (both driven by gas prices): electricity 0.10-0.30 EUR/kWh, heat 0.033-0.10 EUR/kWh. Scenario range, not a market forecast.

fruit_price_eur_per_kg.note: Scenario range around the contract value 2.0.

fruit_growth_multiplier.note: Unobservable compartment-to-compartment crop vigour; the true score averages over it.

leakage_multiplier.note: Unobservable compartment-to-compartment airtightness; the true score averages over it.

weather.campaign_year: one complete Cabauw year per site from the formal pool
weather.evaluation_years: independent complete years from a separate pool, shared across methods
weather.pools: to be fixed after the new untouched years are acquired and audited; all years downloaded so far (2012-2014, 2016-2020) are development years; candidates are listed in configs/weather_formal_acquisition_proposal_v0.json

exclusion_rules: numerical failure of the physical model under the fixed reference policy (pre-registered replay and retry protocol applies first)
missing or failed weather audit for the drawn year
